name: error-game
description: ERROR — jogo de pegadinhas e raciocínio lateral com web app, PWA e API.

scripts.dev: npm run build -w @error/shared && concurrently -k -n API,WEB -c yellow,green "npm:dev:api" "npm:dev:web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @error/shared && npm run build -w @error/api && npm run build -w @error/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @error/shared && npm run typecheck -w @error/api && npm run typecheck -w @error/web
